title: Naruto in Steampunk Cauldron
description: A massive, rusty, cylindrical steampunk machine covered in warning labels and pipes sits on a stone ledge overlooking a dark fantasy city. Inside a glowing rectangular window, the character Naruto Uzumaki is visible making a hand seal, while dragons fly across a dramatic orange and purple sky with a large red moon.
prompt: A giant rusty steampunk cauldron machine covered in yellow warning labels and leaking orange fluid, sitting on a stone balcony above a gothic fantasy city at night. Inside a large glowing screen window, Naruto Uzumaki in his classic orange and black jacket is visible making a hand sign with both hands. Dragons flying in a dramatic purple and orange sky with a huge red moon, paper lanterns floating on the river below, dark castle architecture in background, cinematic lighting, detailed digital painting.
